Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:5:1.hebrew: זבולן עולה, תחום עכו עולה [עמו] - לאו עכו ממש, דעכו מחלק אשר, דכתיב (שופטים א׳:ל״א): "ואשר לא הוריש יושבי עכו"; אלא כלומר, תחום שבצד עכו:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:5:1.english: "Zevulun ascends, and the territory of Akko ascends [with him]" - [This does] not [mean] Akko itself, for Akko belongs to [the tribe of] Asher, as it is written (Judges 1:31): "Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Akko." Rather, it means the territory that is beside Akko.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:7:1.hebrew: העולם הזה יש לו פרדס ואין לו שדה לבן - תימה: דבשלהי מרובה (ב"ק דף פא: ושם ד"ה אין) אמרינן: "מחלוקת ארץ ישראל — אין לך מישראל שאין לו בהר ובשפלה ונגב". ומיהו אית דגרס: "אין לך שבט ושבט מישראל", אבל הכא גרסינן: "אין לך אחד מישראל לעולם הבא", ומשמע לו שער ראובן אחד, היינו לכל אחד ואחד. אי נמי, בעולם הזה אין להם בשוה, מזה כמו מזה, אלא מזה מעט ומזה הרבה; אבל לעולם הבא יש לו מן הכל שיעור שוה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:7:1.english: "This world has an orchard but not a white field" - This is puzzling, for at the end of [the chapter] Merubah (Bava Kamma 81b, s.v. ein) we say: "Regarding the division of Eretz Yisrael — there is no one of Israel who does not have [a portion] in the hill country, in the lowland, and in the Negev." However, there are those who read: "There is no tribe among the tribes of Israel [that lacks this]." But here we read: "There is no individual of Israel in the World to Come [who lacks...]," and it implies that he has the Reuben gate alone, that is, for each and every one. Alternatively, in this world they do not have equal [portions], this one like that one, but rather this one has a little and that one has a lot; but in the World to Come, each has an equal measure of everything.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:9:1.hebrew: ואידך למאן - אע"ג דכתיב "שער לוי אחד", הא כתיב נמי "שער יוסף אחד", דלא מנו שבט יוסף אלא כאחד:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:9:1.english: "And the other – for whom?" - Even though it is written "one gate of Levi," it is also written "one gate of Joseph," for they counted the tribe of Joseph only as one.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:9:2.hebrew: לא סלקא דעתך דכתיב הנותר לנשיא וגו' - ובב"ר בפר"ב דריש מהכא דגבעוני אינו מתרפא לעתיד לבא, מדכתיב: "והעובד העיר וגו'". ואיתא להא ואיתא להא, ומדאפקיה בלשון עובד, דרוש ביה נמי גבעוני. או שמא פליגי:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 122a:9:2.english: "It cannot enter your mind, for it is written: 'The remainder is for the prince,' etc." - And in Bereishit Rabbah, in the second chapter, [the Sages] expound from here that a Gibeonite will not be healed in the future, from the fact that it is written: "And the worker of the city," etc. And [the two teachings] are both present [in the verses]; and since [the verse] expressed it with the term "worker," expound it as referring to the Gibeonite as well. Or perhaps they disagree.
